Author: S.K. Sahoo

 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crla No.20 of 2024
 Ajit Balua .... Appellant
 Mr. S.K. Jena, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Respondent
 Mr. Rajesh Tripathy
 Addl.

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo

This matter is taken up through Hybrid
arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Call for the trial Court record.

Since one of the offences under which the appellant is found guilty is under section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code, let the learned counsel for the appellant serve an extra copy of the appeal memo along with the impugned judgment so also all its annexures on the learned counsel for the State by tomorrow (17.01.2024), who shall send the same to the Inspector-in-Charge of Burla police station (in Burla P.S. Case No.04 of 2019) for its service on the informant and it will be intimated to her that the matter is likely to be taken up in the week // 2 //
commencing from 29th January 2024 and if she so likes, she can engage a counsel to oppose the prayer for bail.
A written proof regarding service of notice be obtained from the informant.
Put up this matter in the week commencing from 29th January 2024.
Instruction regarding service of notice on the informant shall be obtained in the meantime.
